measurement_scope: Separate verification process holding extra tables and independent arrays; these are separate phase microbenchmarks, not additive decomposition of measured CLI time.
retained_model: 336 local rates, 28 product totals, 12 store totals, scalar grand total; no persisted learned estimator
complexity: Selected fit O(transactions + days*keys) including panel preparation; prediction O(keys). Memory O(rows + days*keys); model state O(keys).
compatibility: Actual CLI peak under 0.2 GiB and subsecond wall time for 17,406 sales rows and 336 operating keys. Fits CPU-only 8 GB RAM computer with substantial OS headroom for this workload; current host RAM not assumed. No parallel workers, GPU, neural networks, sklearn or network dependency. Larger future extracts need fresh measurement.
candidate_workload: All candidates have per-origin fit+inference times and whole comparison peak RSS in development_results.json; ridge retains about two years * 336 examples * 10 float64 features, a few MB plus arrays; no unbounded search.
